distil.nudge.length: word count past the statement length
distil.nudge.length_about: Catches a statement longer than the statement length in Project settings. That is 15 words unless you change it. For example, "Walking the dog each morning before work becomes the one part of the day she keeps for herself" has 18 words.
distil.nudge.lead: opens with She, He or They
distil.nudge.lead_about: Catches a statement that opens with She, Her, He, His, They or Their. For example, "She feels calmer once the dog is asleep".
distil.nudge.quote_about: Catches inverted commas inside a statement. For example, "Feels 'properly at home' with the dog around".
distil.nudge.semicolon_about: Catches a semicolon inside a statement. For example, "Missing the dog; dreading the empty flat".
distil.nudge.emdash_about: Catches an em dash (the long dash). For example, "Calm at home — restless on the walk".
distil.nudge.arrow_about: Catches an arrow (→ or ->) inside a statement. For example, "Fear → trust on the second walk".
distil.nudge.readsas_about: Catches reads, casts or recasts followed by as. For example, "Reads the barking at the door as a warning".
